name: Request Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the request used to further detail the type of information that will be queried.

RT01.name: Release Pending
RT01.definition: Type is a request to release the pending transactions.

RT02.name: Hold Normal
RT02.definition: Type is a request to hold normal transactions.

RT03.name: Cancellation
RT03.definition: Type is a request to cancellation a transaction.

RT04.name: Re Sequence
RT04.definition: Type is a request to change the sequence of the transactions.

RT05.name: Release Suspicious
RT05.definition: Type is a request to release the suspicious transactions.
